pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Sub-angular to rounded dark brown polygonal regions with soft edge gradients. Spatial area is heterogeneous, being larger and more regular on the neck and shoulder, transitioning to smaller, more irregularly shaped regions on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous web of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. The pixel thickness of these pathways is relatively uniform, forming a stable topological graph across the visible torso and neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-profile mane along the dorsal neck line, exhibiting a fine-grained, low-amplitude serrated contour with high frequency against the out-of-focus background.
